name: AstroMycology
description: Static database for mushroom imagery — RGB photos, RGB-thermal photos, and 3D scans — with an in-browser Three.js 3D viewer/analysis tool and client-side calibration-marker scale & colour recovery on flat photos. Sources: Epicollect5, public GitHub folders, or local upload (including HEIC). Deploys to GitHub Pages. No server, no Google GenAI.
